title: The canonical scalar-inclusion arrow is the derived tensor-comparison mate
statement: For the explicit constructions of [def-weil-pbc-condensed-coefficient-complex-diagram] and the fixed derived adjunctions and tensor comparisons of [def-weil-pbc-finite-derived-tensor-comparison], let E,F,G be finite intermediate coefficient fields with E≤G and F≤G, and C any complex of F_X-modules. Transpose the explicit stage comparison under the finite derived adjunction, extend to the algebraic closure, conjugate by the prescribed tensor comparisons, and transpose under the algebraic-closure adjunction. The resulting morphism equals Q of the explicitly constructed scalar-inclusion map followed by the explicit vertex comparison. This assertion has no filtered category, finality, cocone universal property, or existential choice of complexes or isomorphisms.

theorem coefficientComplexToAlgCl_derived_compatibility
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    {E F G : FiniteIntermediateField ℓ} (he : E ≤ G) (hf : F ≤ G)
    (C : CochainComplex
      (Mod (Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (padicSubfieldRingObj X ℓ F)) ℤ) :
    finiteCoefficientDerivedAlgClHomEquiv X ℓ E
      (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((coefficientComplexStage X ℓ he hf).obj C)) _
      ((finiteCoefficientDerivedTensorCompIso X ℓ he).inv.app
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((coefficientComplexStage X ℓ he hf).obj C)) ≫
        (finiteCoefficientDerivedToAlgCl X ℓ G).map
          ((finiteCoefficientDerivedHomEquiv X ℓ he
              (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((coefficientComplexStage X ℓ he hf).obj C)) _).symm
            (coefficientComplexStageIso X ℓ he hf C).hom) ≫
        (finiteCoefficientDerivedTensorCompIso X ℓ hf).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C)) =
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (coefficientComplexToAlgCl X ℓ he hf C) ≫
        (coefficientComplexVertexIso X ℓ (E := E) C).hom
